unlock.pin.attempts: Tries left before the PIN is deleted: {count}
unlock.pin.error.out_of_memory: This device did not have enough memory to check the PIN. It is not a wrong PIN, but the try still counts as one of the five.
unlock.pin.error.pin_offline_expired: The PIN needs contact with the server: it is more than 7 days since the last contact, or the clock was changed. Check the connection and try again, or use your master password.
unlock.pin.error.pin_rule: That PIN is not one the rule of this server allows (too short or too long). It did not count as a try.
unlock.pin.error.pin_unavailable: PIN unlock is not available now. Use your master password.
unlock.pin.error.pin_wait: You have to wait before the next try.
unlock.pin.error.pin_wiped: The PIN on this device was deleted: after five wrong tries, because the administrator changed or turned off the PIN rule, or because it no longer matched your account. Use your master password to open the vault. You can set a new PIN in the settings.
unlock.pin.error.removed_note: The PIN on this device was deleted too.
unlock.pin.error.too_long: The PIN has at most {max} characters.
unlock.pin.error.too_short: The PIN has at least {min} characters.
unlock.pin.error.wrong_pin: That PIN is not right. {count} tries left before the PIN is deleted.
unlock.pin.error.wrong_pin_last: That PIN is not right. This is your last try. After that the PIN is deleted and you need your master password.
unlock.pin.hint: The 123 button only changes the keyboard that opens. Your PIN can still be letters or other characters.
unlock.pin.label: PIN
unlock.pin.lead: Enter your PIN to open the vault.
unlock.pin.numeric.label: 123 keyboard
unlock.pin.offline_first: The PIN has to reach the server first (it is more than 7 days since the last contact, or the clock was changed). Unlock with PIN tries that now.
